messages:
Taylor (Design): quick heads-up from testing: on compact density the row kebab menu on the Models list gets partially covered by a success toast that appears bottom-right. testers on small phones kept tapping the toast instead of the menu item :grimacing:
Ben - Eng: can you drop repro steps + viewport?
Taylor (Design): Models -> List view, narrow width (~360px). open kebab, trigger quick action (e.g., Promote) which fires a toast. gif attached. the first menu item sits under the toast and is hard to tap.
Anika (Design Systems): thanks — likely two issues: compact token aliases lowered visual padding and our button hit areas shrank below the 44px recommended minimum; plus some containers use `transform` which creates a new stacking context so poppers fall under fixed toasts.
Marco (PM): user impact is real — people think the action didn't go through or they accidentally activate the toast. also copy "Saved" is vague in these flows, we should be contextual where possible.
Ben - Eng: short-term quick patch: when a popover/kebab opens add `data-interactive-open` on body and have toasts avoid overlapping elements marked with that attribute. also toggle `pointer-events: none` on the toast for 250ms while a menu is opening. Not perfect but reduces accidental taps.
Anika (Design Systems): long-term plan: 1) introduce a `--touch-target-min` token set to 44px and make compact aliases honour it (visual padding can remain compact but hit area preserved via negative margin/padding technique), 2) render poppers into a top-layer portal to avoid transform stacking traps, 3) add a toast positioning rule to auto-shift if it would overlap any element with `data-interactive-open` or `:focus-visible` areas.
Taylor (Design): also accessibility note: keyboard focus rings are being obscured when toasts appear. we should guarantee `:focus-visible` outlines render above toasts or toasts reposition away from focused controls.
Marco (PM): copy suggestion: instead of generic "Saved" use contextual messages like "Version saved" or "Connection updated" depending on source. helps reduce confusion when multiple toasts can appear.
Ben - Eng: implementation notes: we'll also shorten toast enter animation to 160ms (was 320ms) so overlaps are briefer, and we'll toggle `pointer-events` only after the entrance finishes. For toasts with actions (undo) we need to ensure pointer-events are restored if a popover isn't open.
Anika (Design Systems): I'll add a tokens lint that fails CI if any density alias produces an effective hit area < `--touch-target-min`. also adding `--toast-edge-gap` token so toasts keep a safe distance from viewport edges (recommend half the touch-target).
ci-bot: opened PR `design/toast-kebab-guard-1759` — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/pr/4001 :eyes: CI checks running
Ben - Eng: tested the PR on staging (Chrome + iOS Safari emulation). popovers sit above toasts, the temporary pointer-events toggle works, and the shorter animation reduces brief overlaps. left screenshots in the PR.
Taylor (Design): nice — a couple of small follow-ups: 1) add Percy snapshots for 320/375 widths with open kebab + toast, 2) update tokens README to document `--touch-target-min` and the negative-margin pattern for preserving hit area, 3) change toast copy strings to be contextual where event metadata is available.
Anika (Design Systems): agreed. I'll add the lint and update the compact alias set. Marco, can you sign off on the copy variants so we can wire them in?
Marco (PM): will compile a short mapping of common toasts -> contextual text and post here by EOD. thanks everyone — good catch and solid plan :thumbsup:
